label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交限制 XPath 语法树深度以防栈溢出：新增编译期配置宏 PUGIXML_XPATH_DEPTH_LIMIT（configuration，带默认值 1024），并在解析超深表达式时抛出新的 xpath_exception 错误（lifecycle：新的错误通道）。表面上同时具有“新宏”和“新错误通道”两种隐式阳性特征。但宏有默认值、无需在构建中定义；fuzz_xpath 本就用 try/catch 捕获 xpath_exception，新的错误会被既有处理吸收，而嵌套括号等超深表达式很容易由 fuzzer 生成；定额 fuzz 下深度计数与报错代码在多个种子中被执行。harness 无需修改，属于隐式 mix(configuration+lifecycle) 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit limits XPath AST depth to prevent stack overflow: a new compile-time macro PUGIXML_XPATH_DEPTH_LIMIT (configuration, defaulting to 1024) and a new xpath_exception raised for over-deep expressions (lifecycle: a new error channel). On the surface it shows both silent-positive traits, a new macro and a new error channel. But the macro has a default and needs no build definition, fuzz_xpath already catches xpath_exception so the new error is absorbed by existing handling, and over-deep expressions such as nested parentheses are easy for the fuzzer to produce; under the fuzz budget the depth accounting and error code run in several seeds. No harness update needed: silent mix(configuration+lifecycle) negative.
